technical-summary: First step of the clean-cut capability-model migration (PC01/PC06): capability_catalogue.py now accepts the final tier name `provisioned` and normalizes the legacy `automation` label to it at load; and loads families from a merged `families:` section in _capabilities.yaml when present, falling back to the standalone _families.yaml. Both changes are additive/non-breaking (the shipped catalogue still loads: 31 kinds, 9 families). Updated test_capability_catalogue.py to assert the normalized `provisioned` tier. Full capability catalogue + facts unit suites green (34 tests).
user-summary-candidate: Began the provider capability-model migration: the catalogue loader now speaks the new `provisioned` tier and supports a single merged catalogue file, without breaking the existing configuration.

technical-summary: Fixed two stale test cases left by PC01's FamilyRegistrar refactor (pin -> family_id): updated FamilyRegistrar(pin=pin,...) constructions to FamilyRegistrar(family_id=pin.family_id,...) and the registrar.pin assertion to registrar.family_id. test_declarative_recipe_adapter.py now green (20 tests). Remaining 2 provider-suite failures (runtime.harness import boundary; pi executable-mock) are pre-existing and belong to the harness-extraction / execution-toolchains workstreams, not the capability model.
user-summary-candidate: Fixed capability-model test cases left stale by the family-registry refactor.

technical-summary: Slimmed the capability evidence model per the 'trail not process' directive: removed the review-process validation from validate_provider_capability_facts (evidence_tier membership / review_state membership / verified-requires-tool_version+fact_anchor, i.e. VAL-PCAP-003/004/005) and the EVIDENCE_TIERS/REVIEW_STATES frozensets; dropped the mandatory fact_anchor requirement for external: subjects. Evidence remains a plain provenance trail (fields still parse, backward-compatible with existing provider YAMLs); identity (empty/duplicate id) and subject-linkage checks retained. Deleted the obsolete test_loader_rejects_invalid_evidence parametrized test. Capability facts + catalogue unit suites green (31 tests).
user-summary-candidate: Simplified capability evidence to a plain provenance trail, removing the review-state/tier validation workflow.

technical-summary: Wired the unified `capabilities:` descriptor block (PC02): added _build_capabilities loader builder + PROVIDER_SPEC registration. Parses a `capabilities:` mapping of catalogue-kind -> {mechanism, modes?} (list value supported for list-cardinality kinds) into the existing ProviderDescriptor.capabilities: tuple[Capability,...] field; validates each kind against the catalogue (VAL-PCAP-009); mechanism kept as declared (typed projection + ref resolution are a follow-up). Additive and non-breaking: providers without a capabilities: block default to empty, so existing descriptors are unaffected. Verified: existing providers load empty, a capabilities: block parses, unknown kinds raise. Loader + catalogue + facts suites green (49 tests).
user-summary-candidate: Providers can now declare the unified capabilities: block; the loader parses and validates it against the capability catalogue.

technical-summary: PC02 mechanism projection + PC01 tier rename (no-leftovers). loader.py: added _build_managed_config_spec (generic ManagedConfigSpec for all managed-reconcile kinds; remote modifier opt-in) and _project_mechanism, which shapes each capability's declared mechanism into its typed form per the catalogue mechanism_schema (managed-config-spec->ManagedConfigSpec, cli-install-recipe->CliInstallRecipe, permissions-struct->ProviderPermissions, host-capability->HostCapability, agent-file->AgentFile, callable-ref->resolved; primitives kept raw). _build_capabilities now projects mechanisms. Renamed the authority tier automation->provisioned across _capabilities.yaml (10 kinds) and REMOVED the transitional automation alias + normalization from capability_catalogue.py (no leftovers). Verified: capabilities: block projects typed mechanisms; catalogue loads with only provisioned/operational/evidence-only; 51 provider tests green.
user-summary-candidate: The capabilities: block now produces fully-typed mechanisms, and the automation tier was cleanly renamed to provisioned with no legacy alias left behind.

technical-summary: PC02 forward-derivation bridge + RV841 hook kind. Added a data-driven _FLAT_CAPABILITY_MAP + _derive_capabilities that projects the legacy flat descriptor fields (cli_install, mcp_config, hooks_config, model_config, plugin_config, language_servers_config, fetch_catalog_fn, on_lsp_enabled, skill_surface_path, instruction_file, surfaces, host_capabilities[list], agent_files[list], permissions, deprecated, supported_connectors) into the unified ProviderDescriptor.capabilities tuple, with the already-typed flat objects as mechanisms. Wired into _construct_provider_descriptor (derives only when no explicit capabilities: block). Added the missing hook-config catalogue kind (family managed-hooks) so codex's hooks derive (closes the RV841 orphaned-family gap). Verified: all 16 providers now expose a derived capabilities view (110 capabilities total), codex includes hook-config, mechanisms are typed (claude mcp-config -> ManagedConfigSpec). No provider YAML rewrite required; consumers can now read descriptor.capabilities uniformly.
user-summary-candidate: Every provider now exposes the unified capabilities view (derived from its existing config), so downstream code can read one shape without any provider rewrite.

technical-summary: MAJOR capability-model reduction (big-bang). Removed ~17 flat capability fields from ProviderDescriptor (cli_install, mcp_config, model_config, plugin_config, hooks_config, language_servers_config, host_capabilities, permissions, agent_files, capability_facts, automation_capabilities, fetch_catalog_fn, on_lsp_enabled, skill_surface_path, instruction_file, surfaces, supported_connectors) and replaced them with @property accessors that project from the unified `capabilities` tuple; automation_capabilities is now SYNTHESIZED from the catalogue (family+contracts+modes, deduped, with generated-surfaces universal). The loader constructor consumes parsed flat blocks into `capabilities` (_capabilities_from_values) and drops the flat keys. Catalogue fixes: ownership_scope_required on managed-mcp/managed-hooks/plugin-entry families; surface-skill/surface-instruction under generated-surfaces; model-catalog-refresh -> operational (it is a query, not model-projection reconcile). Deleted the obsolete test_provider_capability_facts.py (capability_facts feature removed); converted surface/model/feature/catalogue test helpers to construct via capabilities. Provider unit suite green except the 2 pre-existing out-of-lane failures (harness imports, pi mock).
user-summary-candidate: Major code reduction: removed ~17 redundant descriptor fields; the unified capability map is now the single source, with flat accessors projecting from it.

technical-summary: 1) Added pip toolchain to toolchains.yaml (install/uninstall). 2) Rewrote INSTALL_MAP with canonical documented Hindsight integration methods per provider — replaces the earlier map which reflected AUDiaGentic preference order rather than actual Hindsight documentation. Key changes: Aider uses hindsight-aider wrapper, Claude/OpenCode use plugins, Cline uses hooks, Goose/Qwen/Gemini paths corrected, compound installs for Copilot/Roo/OpenHands.
user-summary-candidate: Add pip toolchain and rewrite Hindsight INSTALL_MAP to reflect canonical documented integration methods

technical-summary: Converted coding_lsp LSP-provision test constructions to the reduced descriptor shape. Added a _desc(provider_id, display_name, **flat) helper that routes legacy flat kwargs (on_lsp_enabled, mcp_config, ...) into the unified capabilities map via loader._capabilities_from_values, drops now-synthesized automation_capabilities, and keeps surviving fields (lsp_support_probe, receive_lsp_mcp) as direct kwargs; replaced all ProviderDescriptor(...) construction sites with _desc(...). test_provider_lsp_provision.py green (12 tests). Verified _derive_capabilities has no remaining code references. Provider unit suite + coding_lsp green except the 2 pre-existing out-of-lane failures.
user-summary-candidate: Updated LSP-provision tests to the reduced provider descriptor shape.

technical-summary: Added _serialize_section_value() to item_store.py: converts dict/list values into markdown bullet lists when creating or updating plan items and reviews. Strings pass through unchanged; dicts become nested bullet lists with bold labels; lists become top-level bullet points. Wired into create_item, update_item, create_review, update_review so callers can supply structured data (dicts/lists) for section values and they are automatically rendered as readable markdown.
user-summary-candidate: Plan items and reviews now accept structured dict/list section values, automatically rendered as markdown bullet lists.

technical-summary: plan_list_items now requires at least one of 'plan' or 'id_prefix' — unbounded scans are no longer allowed. Raises VAL-PLN-026 (validation) when neither is provided, with a helpful message suggesting filter options. Default limit reduced from 50 to 20.
user-summary-candidate: plan_list_items now requires a plan or id_prefix filter, preventing unbounded scans.

technical-summary: Added plugin-entry family declaration to claude.yaml (Claude Code uses a marketplace plugin for Hindsight, not managed-mcp). Added managed-hooks family declaration to cline.yaml (Cline uses hooks for Hindsight integration). Both entries include payload_contract, result_contract, supported_modes, and ownership_scope_required flags.
user-summary-candidate: Added Hindsight family declarations: plugin-entry for Claude Code, managed-hooks for Cline.

technical-summary: _capabilities.yaml: (1) renamed authority automation -> provisioned across all automation-tier kinds, (2) added hook-config kind (domain: hook, family managed-hooks), (3) moved surface-skill and surface-instruction from operational to provisioned under generated-surfaces family, (4) model-catalog-refresh moved from automation to operational. _families.yaml: added ownership_scope_required: true to managed-mcp, managed-hooks, plugin-entry families.
user-summary-candidate: Capability catalogue config updated: tier rename complete, hook-config kind added, surface kinds under generated-surfaces, ownership_scope required on key families.

technical-summary: Corrected Hindsight family preference order: plugin-entry now beats managed-mcp (Claude Code and OpenCode should use full-integration plugins over raw MCP). New order: managed-hooks > plugin-entry > managed-mcp. Previous order incorrectly placed managed-mcp before plugin-entry.
user-summary-candidate: Fixed Hindsight family priority so plugin-entry beats managed-mcp for providers like Claude that have full-integration plugins.

technical-summary: Added hindsight-aider recipe: installs the `hindsight-aider` wrapper package via pip and writes ~/.hindsight/aider.json configuration with API URL, bank_id (default: aider), and optional token. Aider has no MCP client or lifecycle hooks; the wrapper uses Aider's read-only context-file support before a session and its chat-history file after.
user-summary-candidate: Added Aider Hindsight integration recipe using the hindsight-aider wrapper package.

technical-summary: Two new test suites for provider materialization: (1) test_materialize_dispatch tests the public_materialize.materialize_provider_config() dispatcher directly, covering pi and opencode providers; (2) test_materialize_full_chain tests the end-to-end path through providers_api.materialize_provider_config(), verifying models.json and settings.json are written correctly.
user-summary-candidate: Added provider materialization dispatch and full-chain tests for pi and opencode.

technical-summary: Created CC48: reorganize providers/services into subdirectories by functional domain. 47 files in src/audiagentic/components/providers/services/ are flat and growing; dependency analysis shows a clean DAG with no circular references enabling a safe reorganization.
user-summary-candidate: Added CC48 plan item: reorganize provider services into subdirectories by functional domain.

technical-summary: Created DE04: correct Hindsight installation routes per canonical INSTALL_MAP audit. Current implementation uses wrong family preference order for several providers; key corrections needed for Claude (plugin-entry not managed-mcp), Cline (managed-hooks not managed-mcp), and others.
user-summary-candidate: Added DE04 plan item: correct Hindsight installation routes per canonical documentation.
